## 1. Architecture Overview

My Thai Star is a reference full-stack restaurant-management application with **three independent backends** sharing a common REST API contract and a single Angular SPA.

```mermaid
graph TB
    subgraph Frontend["🖥️ Angular SPA (TypeScript / NgRx)"]
        APP[AppModule]
        MENU[MenuModule]
        BOOK[BookTableModule]
        COCK[WaiterCockpitModule]
        USER[UserAreaModule]
    end

    subgraph JavaBE["☕ Java Backend (Spring Boot / Devon4j)"]
        direction TB
        JREST[REST Service Layer]
        JLOGIC[Logic / Facade Layer]
        JREPO[Repository / Data Access Layer]
        JENTITY[JPA Entities]
    end

    subgraph NodeBE["🟢 Node.js Backend (NestJS / TypeORM)"]
        direction TB
        NCTRL[NestJS Controllers]
        NSVC[Services + Use Cases]
        NREPO[TypeORM Repositories]
        NENTITY[TypeORM Entities]
    end

    subgraph DB["🗄️ Shared H2 / MySQL Database"]
        BOOKING[(Booking)]
        ORDER[(Orders)]
        DISH[(Dish)]
        USER_T[(User)]
    end

    APP --> MENU & BOOK & COCK & USER
    MENU -->|"POST dishmanagement/v1/dish/search"| JavaBE
    BOOK -->|"POST bookingmanagement/v1/booking"| JavaBE
    COCK -->|"POST bookingmanagement/v1/booking/search"| JavaBE
    MENU -->|"POST dishmanagement/v1/dish/search"| NodeBE
    BOOK -->|"POST bookingmanagement/v1/booking"| NodeBE

    JREST --> JLOGIC --> JREPO --> JENTITY
    JENTITY --> DB

    NCTRL --> NSVC --> NREPO --> NENTITY
    NENTITY --> DB
```

```mermaid
    end

    RS -->|delegates all calls to| IMPL
```

## 4. Java Backend — Bookingmanagement Logic Flow

### `saveBooking()` method — Control Flow

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    START([saveBooking called with BookingCto]) --> NOTNULL
    NOTNULL[Objects.requireNonNull booking] --> MAP_ENT
    MAP_ENT[getBeanMapper.map BookingCto → BookingEntity] --> SET_CANCEL
    SET_CANCEL[bookingEntity.setCanceled = false] --> MAP_GUESTS
    MAP_GUESTS[getBeanMapper.mapList invitedGuests → List~InvitedGuestEntity~] --> LOOP_GUESTS

    LOOP_GUESTS{For each\nInvitedGuestEntity} -->|has guests| TRY_TOKEN
    LOOP_GUESTS -->|no guests| SET_DATES

    TRY_TOKEN[Try buildToken email GB_ prefix] --> MD5_OK{MD5 available?}
    MD5_OK -->|Yes| SET_GUEST_TOKEN[invite.setGuestToken token]
    MD5_OK -->|No| LOG_MD5[LOG.debug MD5 not available]
    SET_GUEST_TOKEN --> SET_ACCEPTED
    LOG_MD5 --> SET_ACCEPTED
    SET_ACCEPTED[invite.setAccepted = false] --> LOOP_GUESTS

    SET_DATES[bookingEntity.setCreationDate = Instant.now] --> SET_EXPIRY
    SET_EXPIRY["bookingEntity.setExpirationDate = bookingDate minus 1h"] --> SAVE_ENTITY
    SAVE_ENTITY[getBookingDao.save bookingEntity → resultEntity] --> LOOP_SAVE_GUESTS

    LOOP_SAVE_GUESTS{For each\nresultEntity.invitedGuests} -->|guest| SET_BOOKING_ID
    SET_BOOKING_ID[invitedGuest.setBookingId = resultEntity.getId] --> SAVE_GUEST
    SAVE_GUEST[getInvitedGuestDao.save invitedGuest] --> LOOP_SAVE_GUESTS
    LOOP_SAVE_GUESTS -->|done| SEND_MAIL

    SEND_MAIL[sendConfirmationEmails resultEntity] --> RETURN
    RETURN([Return getBeanMapper.map resultEntity → BookingEto])

    classDef start fill:#1565C0,color:#fff,stroke:#0D47A1
    classDef action fill:#2E7D32,color:#fff,stroke:#1B5E20
    classDef decision fill:#E65100,color:#fff,stroke:#BF360C
    classDef end_node fill:#4A148C,color:#fff,stroke:#311B92

    class START,RETURN start
    class NOTNULL,MAP_ENT,SET_CANCEL,MAP_GUESTS,TRY_TOKEN,SET_GUEST_TOKEN,LOG_MD5,SET_ACCEPTED,SET_DATES,SET_EXPIRY,SAVE_ENTITY,SET_BOOKING_ID,SAVE_GUEST,SEND_MAIL action
    class LOOP_GUESTS,MD5_OK,LOOP_SAVE_GUESTS decision
```

### `buildToken()` — MD5 Token Generation Flow

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    INPUT([email + type]) --> GET_NOW[Instant.now]
    GET_NOW --> FORMAT[Format YYYYMMDD_HHmmss]
    FORMAT --> MD5_INST[MessageDigest.getInstance MD5]
    MD5_INST --> UPDATE["md.update((email+date+time).getBytes())"]
    UPDATE --> DIGEST[md.digest → byte array]
    DIGEST --> FOREACH{for each byte}
    FOREACH -->|byte| APPEND["sb.append(String.format('%02x', b & 0xff))"]
    APPEND --> FOREACH
    FOREACH -->|done| RETURN_TOKEN(["return type + date + sb.toString()"])

    classDef action fill:#1565C0,color:#fff
    class GET_NOW,FORMAT,MD5_INST,UPDATE,DIGEST,APPEND action
```

## 8. NestJS Entity Model

### TypeORM Entity Relationships (Node.js)

```mermaid
classDiagram
    direction TD

    class BaseEntity {
        <<abstract>>
        +number id
        +number modificationCounter
    }

    class Booking {
        <<@Entity Table=Booking>>
        +number? userId
        +string name
        +string? bookingToken
        +string? comment
        +string email
        +Date bookingDate
        +Date? expirationDate
        +Date? creationDate
        +boolean? canceled
        +number? bookingType
        +number? tableId
        +number? orderId
        +number? assistants
        +InvitedGuest[]? invitedGuests
        +Table? table
        +Order? order
        +User? user
        +create(Partial~Booking~)$ Booking
    }

    class InvitedGuest {
        <<@Entity Table=InvitedGuest>>
        +number bookingId
        +string? guestToken
        +string? email
        +boolean? accepted
        +Date? modificationDate
        +number? orderId
        +Booking? booking
        +Order? order
        +create(Partial~InvitedGuest~)$ InvitedGuest
    }

    class Table {
        <<@Entity Table=Table>>
        +number seatsNumber
    }

    class Order {
        <<@Entity Table=Orders>>
        +number bookingId
        +number? invitedGuestId
        +number? hostId
        +Booking? booking
        +OrderLine[]? orderLines
    }

    class OrderLine {
        <<@Entity Table=OrderLine>>
        +number dishId
        +number? amount
        +string? comment
        +number? orderId
        +Order? order
        +Dish? dish
        +Ingredient[]? ingredients
    }

    class Dish {
        <<@Entity Table=Dish>>
        +string? name
        +string? description
        +number? price
        +number imageId
        +Image image
        +Category[]? categories
        +Ingredient[]? ingredients
    }

    class Category {
        <<@Entity Table=Category>>
        +string name
        +string? description
    }

    class Ingredient {
        <<@Entity Table=Ingredient>>
        +string name
        +string? description
        +number? price
    }

    BaseEntity <|-- Booking
    BaseEntity <|-- InvitedGuest
    BaseEntity <|-- Table
    BaseEntity <|-- Order
    BaseEntity <|-- OrderLine
    BaseEntity <|-- Dish
    BaseEntity <|-- Category
    BaseEntity <|-- Ingredient

    Booking "1" *-- "0..*" InvitedGuest : OneToMany (cascade, onDelete=CASCADE)
    Booking "n" --> "1" Table : ManyToOne (idTable)
    Booking "n" --> "0..1" Order : ManyToOne (idOrder)

    InvitedGuest "n" --> "1" Booking : ManyToOne (idBooking)
    InvitedGuest "n" --> "0..1" Order : ManyToOne (idOrder, onDelete=CASCADE)

    Order "1" --> "0..1" Booking : OneToOne (idBooking)
    Order "1" *-- "0..*" OrderLine : OneToMany (onUpdate=CASCADE)

    OrderLine "n" --> "1" Order : ManyToOne (idOrder)
    OrderLine "n" --> "1" Dish : ManyToOne (idDish)
    OrderLine "n" <--> "n" Ingredient : ManyToMany (OrderDishExtraIngredient)

    Dish "n" --> "1" Image : ManyToOne (idImage)
    Dish "n" <--> "n" Category : ManyToMany (DishCategory)
    Dish "n" <--> "n" Ingredient : ManyToMany (DishIngredient)
```

## 10. Design Patterns Catalogue

| Pattern | Location | Files |
